title: WAC 296-17A-0518, Classification 0518 (nonwood frame buildings and structures)

passages.question: Which Q3 jobs belong in 0518, non-wood frame buildings?
passages.excerpt: 0518-00 Nonwood frame buildings and structures, new construction and repair, N.O.C. Applies to work on nonwood frame buildings and structures ... when the superstructure (skeleton framework or building shell) consists of concrete, iron or steel, or a combination of concrete, iron, steel and/or wood ... Pouring and finishing concrete within the building or structure such as: ... Precast or poured in place load bearing floors or wall panels; ... The raising and/or standing up (by crane or boom) of concrete: Tilt-up walls; ... Metal frames. ...
